messages.en:
{07 02 00}Oh, no.{01 00 00 0f 00} This is so awful.
I can't even believe you
found me, {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Yeah, too bad you're
TOO LATE! Nice try though,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}Looks like the master wins
again, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Oh ei.{01 00 00 0f 00} See on nii kohutav.
Ma ei usu isegi, et sa
mind leidsid, {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Jah, kahju, et sa oled
LIIGA HILJA! Hea katse,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}Paistab, et meister võidab
jälle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{03 01 00 01}

{07 11 00}Heh {01 00 00 05 00}heh{01 00 00 05 00} heh.{01 00 00 05 00} Pretty
impressive, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 15 00}Oh, how sad. It looks like
you're too late. {01 00 00 05 00}That means
sweet victory is ALL MINE!
{07 03 00}Muwahaha{01 00 00 05 00} hahahaha!
{07 00 00}But, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess I have
to give you some credit.
{07 15 00}There's no way a kid like
you could beat a master
like me!{03 01 00 01}
